fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestRoadmapMilestones shows, for a two-project root, no row from the other project, the groups in order, titles from the change set's title field with the intent as the clamped sub-line, the state words, and finished milestones folded into one link.
fields.statement: The roadmap shows only its project's open milestones, as in pages/roadmap.html: each with its state in words (building, planned, designing), a segmented progress bar and counts, its done points folded, and its change sets grouped (building now, accepted, landed, drafts) with the short title, the intent clamped to two lines and a state pill; finished milestones fold into one link.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestChangeSetPage shows a landed change set's facts, three leaves with statement, acceptance and a verified Evidence line, its decision, question and source linking to /p/<project>/nodes/<ref>, and its history; a draft with no leaves says it has none yet.
fields.statement: A change set's page shows, as in pages/change-set.html: its title, state and full intent; facts (when it shipped and its PR, its run and duration, the done point it serves, its ID); its leaves with statement, acceptance and Evidence state; why it exists (decisions, questions, sources), each linking to its model page; and its history.
